verdict.rationale: a-Shell documents its own WASI-sdk for cross-compiling programs on another computer into WebAssembly that run inside a-Shell. It also publishes a repository of precompiled commands installable with `pkg`, which is a first-party SDK path for building against the product. The SDK gets only a single brief mention, and there is no official API client SDK: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: SDK documentation and reference, language-specific client SDKs or bindings, any AI- or agent-oriented SDK guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
